description: Nested collections, global Push/Pop, local alternative usage delimiter, string/designator indexes, and opaque long/reserved items. H0 verifies literal item bytes and offsets; H1 must interpret/preserve their semantics.

metadata.h1Expectation: Physical Pointer collection nested under the application
Push complete global state, including report size four and GenericDesktop page
Retain local string index three on the following Main item
Retain local designator index two on the following Main item
Retain ordered alternative delimiter branch containing Vendor FF00 usage two, separate from primary usage one
Input field at payload bit zero, eight bits; Main item consumes and clears local state
Restore complete pushed globals; later field returns to four bits and GenericDesktop page
Input X at payload bit eight, four bits; string/designator/alternative locals must not leak
Constant four-bit padding at payload bit twelve
Preserve full long item including size three, tag zero and opaque payload aabbcc
Preserve unknown reserved-type short item rather than silently discarding it
Close physical child then application parent; preserve collection hierarchy

fields.usage: Vendor FF00:01; alternative FF00:02; string 3; designator 2
